branches.description: The six fixed branches. Each is a QUESTION an orienting agent asks, not a folder it browses. The set is frozen — stability of the top level is what makes any repo navigable in thirty seconds; sub-filing inside a branch is free-form.

unfiled.description: Contract-shaped files whose kind the router does not recognize. Listed, never dropped — an artifact silently absent from the map is the routing failure this surface exists to prevent.

count.description: Present only on an aggregated row: this kind had more files than the map will enumerate, so one row carries the shared directory and the file count. The count participates in freshness — new receipts still change the map.
